source: BBOC 2026 Pac-12 preview (Mike Calabrese / Collin Wilson / Josh 'Duck' Nunn) — full transcript
section_note: 8 REAL members (Boise St, Colorado St, Fresno St, San Diego St, Utah St, Texas St, Washington St, Oregon St). Non-con wks 1-4; 7-game round-robin wks 5-12 (4 home / 3 road, home sites known up front); title game after Wk12; Wk13 = home-and-home FLEX, NOT league-sanctioned (does not affect standings) and books split on whether win totals resolve on 11 or 12 games — Collin/Duck stress betting unders at 11-game books, overs at 12-game books. Full round-robin = NO in-conference 'avoids.' QB detail extracted faithfully from the real pod transcript.

teams.qb_status: Returning — Maddox Madsen (incumbent, no battle). Flagged hard: 35 turnover-worthy plays career, upside-down TD:INT decision-making; when tied-or-trailing 54% comp / 7 INT. 'If you stop the running game, he folds.' Leans on play-action + tight ends.
teams.key_avoids: Full round-robin (plays all 7 other members) — no in-conf avoids. Wk13 FLEX (projected): vs Utah State (may not count). Non-con: @ Oregon, Memphis, @ W. Michigan, South Dakota (FCS).
teams.bboc_notes: Priced favorite to win the league (+170). Book win total 8 (SBD 7.5) — Collin notes that's likely an 11-game number; he 'can't take the under' because the run game (Dylan Riley + Sire Gaines, both ~4.2 yds after contact) is the best in the league and no Pac-12 front stops it; sees 7 wins. Two new coordinators (OC Zach Hill, DC Terrence Brown). Green secondary replacing 4 starters (Roman Tillman in from South Dakota). Hosts Texas State on Halloween — pivotal. Most vulnerable Boise in memory but still deserved favorite.

teams.qb_status: Battle — Haas Haney (4-star HS, 4.45/40 track speed; recruited to TCU, transferred to Oklahoma State, now CSU) vs Darius Curry. Lead: Duck expects Haney to win the job. Mobile dual-threat; Mora wants to structure designed-QB-run offense around him (Brett Hundley archetype).
teams.key_avoids: Full round-robin — no in-conf avoids. Wk13 FLEX (projected): vs Texas State (may not count). Non-con: Wyoming, Southern Utah, BYU, @ UTSA.
teams.bboc_notes: New HC Jim Mora Jr. (back-to-back 9-win seasons at UConn; 9-5 first yr at UCLA) — Collin rates the hire highly, calls it 'ground zero' with 40+ transfers. DC Tyson Summers retained; OC Price Tracy (ex-QB coach, first time full-time play-caller). Collin projects 2.8, ceiling 5, first six games a 'soul search'; hard under (SBD 3.5, book 4). Juice Vereen (TE, 22 rec/5 TD from UConn) a red-zone weapon. High variance from staff/QB/roster reset.

teams.qb_status: Transfer — Christian Martin (from Maryland, where he pushed the starter deep into fall camp). Replaces EJ Warner. Duck: dual-threat element greater than Warner gave; Collin: unproven, 'who's throwing/catching?'
teams.key_avoids: Full round-robin — no in-conf avoids. Wk13 FLEX (projected): vs San Diego State (may not count). Non-con: @ USC (Fri opener), Sacramento St, @ San Jose St, Rice.
teams.bboc_notes: HC Matt Entz returns (yr 2, 2x FCS national champ); both coordinators retained — NOT a staff change. HOST SPLIT: Collin hard under (took only 4 pts off the power rating for lost experience and still lands at 4.5 wins — 'something's not adding up'; SBD 6.5, book 7.5, market was bet up from 5.5→7.5). Duck bullish: power run game (Rayshawn Luke/Bryson Donaldson + Tarik Thomas from Bucknell), elite OL culture, borderline-elite secondary under rising-star DC Nick Benedetto (20 INT last yr — may regress). Fade per Collin.

teams.qb_status: Returning — Jayden Denegal (incumbent, ex-Michigan; deep-ball arm on a surgically repaired shoulder — throws more 20+-yard attempts than short; efficiency collapses vs cover 2/cover 3. Remove the Nevada & Colorado State games and he was 55% / 5 TD / 8 INT). Health is the swing variable; Manu Berta-Manuel a QB→WR convert to watch.
teams.key_avoids: Full round-robin — no in-conf avoids. Wk13 FLEX (projected): vs Fresno State (may not count). Non-con: Portland St, @ UCLA, James Madison, @ Toledo.
teams.key_injury: Denegal — surgically repaired throwing shoulder (season swing variable)
teams.bboc_notes: Sean Lewis yr 3 (3-9 → 9-4, a few plays from 11-2). New DC Demetrius Sumler promoted from within. Defense is a full reset (lost all edge rushers/havoc creators) — 100th returning production on D, 1st on O. Collin/Duck deliverable: BET OVERS every week — 'this offense scores in bombs, this defense is horrific,' 40-41 point games coming. OL could be top-3 in league (Joseph Borjon 6-8/338; Isaac Lucas from Ball State). Lucky Sudden RB (~1300 all-purpose). Book 7 / SBD 6.5. Lewis covered 10 games last yr — persistent market resistance he keeps beating.

teams.qb_status: Battle — McKay Hillstead (returning; played sparingly at USU two years ago, transferred to BYU, came back — very limited FBS snaps) vs Grady Brosterhous. Lean: Hillstead to start. 2024 engine Bryson Barnes (masked a garbage OL — 42 sacks / 88 TFL allowed) departed.
teams.key_avoids: Full round-robin — no in-conf avoids. Wk13 FLEX (projected): vs Boise State (may not count). Non-con: Idaho St, @ Washington, @ Utah, Troy.
teams.bboc_notes: HC Bronco Mendenhall returns (yr 2; went 10-3 ATS in a tough first year). NEW OC Robert Anae ('polarizing' play-caller) + DC Nick Howell. 110th in returning offensive production; receiver room gutted (leading returner Anthony Garcia is a converted QB; transfers Jevon Robinson/Eli Wood unproven). Went hard in portal on D (17 P4 additions, 5th-rated G6 class) but D faded badly late (allowed 170+ rush yds 8x; 122nd in explosive-plays-allowed). Brutal road slate (@ Washington, @ Utah, @ Boise, @ Texas State). Duck bets under 5.5 at 11-game books; Collin makes it exactly 4.5 = no play (SBD 4.5, book 5). High variance.

teams.qb_status: Returning — Brad Jackson (incumbent; pod's 'best G6 quarterback'). 38 all-purpose TDs; 869 rush yds with ~60% on DESIGNED runs (not scrambles); runs GJ Kinne's 10-personnel spread. Command of the offense grew all last year.
teams.key_avoids: Full round-robin — no in-conf avoids. Wk13 FLEX (projected): vs Colorado State (may not count). Non-con gauntlet: @ Texas, UTSA, North Texas, Incarnate Word.
teams.bboc_notes: CORRECTION vs prior data: QB is Brad Jackson (returning), NOT Malik Murphy — Murphy is Oregon State. HC GJ Kinne returns; new co-DC Will Windham (+ Caleb James from Arkansas on the edge, Philip Bradford from McNeese). Elite skill: Bo Sparks + Chris Dawn Jr. (both 1,000-yd, 2.8 yds/route). OL is the risk — 87th sack rate, only ~30% returns (William Boone 6-6/350 in from PVAMU/UNC). Collin's ~7.5 is on an 11-GAME schedule; prefers over 6.5 (+130) or Pac-12 title-game (+200) over the messy tiebreakers (SBD 6.5). Defense (113th quality drives, 115th tackling) must improve marginally. Dark-horse to reach the title game; brutal early slate (@ Texas, UTSA, @ SDSU, @ Boise).

teams.qb_status: Transfer — Kayden Pinnock (from UC Davis; 2025 Big Sky Freshman of the Year; ~185 lbs, 'buck-eighty-five soaking wet' — durability risk). Mobile: ~475+ rush yds (mostly scrambles), 3,000+ pass yds / 32 TD / 10 INT in the Big Sky. Pod: 'right-handed Micah Alii-hado,' plays above his size, low mistake rate.
teams.key_avoids: Full round-robin — no in-conf avoids. Wk13 FLEX (projected): vs Oregon State (may not count). Non-con: @ Washington (Apple Cup), @ Kansas St, Duquesne, Arizona.
teams.bboc_notes: New HC Kirby Moore (ex-Missouri OC; built the Fresno & Missouri offenses) after Jimmy Rogers left for Iowa State. NEW DC Trent Bray (fired as Oregon State HC — pod likes him far better as a DC play-caller; runs his 4-2-5). 5 HCs in 7 years; realignment orphan. Year-zero build but improves week to week — Collin projects ~5.1 on 11 games, likes the alt-over 5.5 (SBD 4.5, book 5). Brutal open (@ Washington Apple Cup, @ Kansas State, Arizona) then a play-on team down the stretch. Portal-populated two-deep; hard to grade.

teams.qb_status: Battle (staff kept it open into August) — Malik Murphy (incumbent; immobile, inaccurate, checkdown merchant; atrocious turnover-worthy-play rate — both hosts down on him) vs Braden Atkinson (Mercer transfer, 2024 Jerry Rice Award = top FCS freshman: 35 total TD / 3,600 pass yds; accurate rhythm thrower, nice deep ball, but blown out by Auburn and lost an FCS playoff 47-0 — needs time). Pod wants the switch to Atkinson.
teams.key_avoids: Full round-robin — no in-conf avoids. Wk13 FLEX (projected): vs Washington State (may not count). Non-con: @ Houston, Texas Tech, Montana (FCS semifinalist), @ UTEP.
teams.bboc_notes: New HC JaMarcus Shepherd (Kalen DeBoer tree) + new DC Mike McIntyre (ex-FIU; Collin likes the hire even though McIntyre's aggressive nickel gives up scores). Likely worst trenches in the league (both sides); 90th in returning OL experience, two new tackles. 5 starters back on D but returned only their top-12 tacklers and were dead-last in passing-downs explosives allowed. Collin projects 3.8 (Juice at 3.5). Brutal open (@ Houston, Texas Tech, Montana top-5 FCS). Only edge is the weird 'red wine & flannel' Corvallis home vibe vs 3 back-to-back-travel visitors (Wazoo, Texas State, Utah State). Under (SBD 4.5).
